fact: The national health insurance institute INAM announced on 27 March 2026 the launch of an online platform, plaintes.inam.tg, for insured people and partners to file and track complaints, beside counters and a toll-free line 8220; no case count is given.

The Ministry of Security launched an online platform on the national public-services portal for citizens to report abuses by security forces, with complainants told of follow-up; no case count is given.
